prototype_feel_reasons: The mobile initial crop hides the right-side worker and much of the third job, weakening the intended three-job scene.
A translucent hotspot is placed directly over the logging machine/saw, obscuring a tool needed to understand the activity.
The partially clipped hotspot at the mobile right edge looks accidental rather than like a deliberate horizontal-navigation affordance.
Large unused space below the scene makes the screen composition feel unfinished despite the polished main illustration.
issues: mobile/main forest scene — initial horizontal crop omits the right-side worker and most of the planting activity — reduce scene width, use a responsive object-position that keeps all three jobs legible, or add a clearer carousel preview/continuation treatment

desktop and mobile/logging-machine hotspot — translucent circular overlay covers the saw/machine that communicates the second job — move the hotspot into nearby negative space and use a leader line if needed

mobile/right-side hotspot — overlay is clipped by the viewport edge, creating an accidental-looking partial circle — reposition it inside the visible frame or hide off-screen hotspots until the user scrolls
screen/main composition — substantial empty lower area makes the scene and guidance feel provisionally placed — tighten the viewport layout or use the space for integrated progress/navigation content
